key_insight: SciFig2Data converts scientific figures in PDFs into structured measurements linked to caption-derived experimental context.
clinical_relevance: The workflow could support biomedical evidence aggregation and AI research, but the abstract does not establish clinical utility.
method: Detect figures, separate panels, and filter content using OCR.
Classify charts with a Swin-based model and reconstruct tables using an instruction-guided multimodal model.
Associate measurements with caption metadata and enable batch processing with caching and logging.
evidence_signal: Across 605 toxicology/pharmacology articles and 551 lipid nanoparticle articles, the workflow reconstructed 468 and 242 tabular outputs, respectively.
watch_item: The abstract reports output counts but not numerical reconstruction accuracy, so recovered data require validation before downstream use.
paper_title: SciFig2Data: A Workflow for Recovering Structured Data from Scientific Figures
